description: Share an entire List (and its tasks) with a guest at a chosen permission level. Returns the updated guest. Enterprise plan only.

guest_id.description: ID of the guest (the guest user's numeric id).

list_id.description: ID of the List to share.

permission_level.description: Permission level to grant: 'read' (view only), 'comment', 'edit', or 'create'.

name: add_guest_to_list
